CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_apply_rank_package_benefits(p_payment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if public.tc_customer_payment_is_current(p_payment_id) then return public.tc_apply_purchase_benefits(p_payment_id); end if;
 return public.tc_apply_rank_package_benefits_before_202611(p_payment_id);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_customer_benefits_config()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object('redemptions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',r.id,'minutes',r.minutos_otorgados,'coins',r.puntos_coste) order by r.minutos_otorgados),'[]') from public.recompensas r where r.activo),
 'package_benefits',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(b)-'updated_by')||case when b.rank_key='diamante' and p.activated_at is not null then
 jsonb_build_object('enabled',true,'coins',p.diamond_purchase_coins,'roulette_level_1_spins',0,'roulette_level_2_spins',0,
 'roulette_level_3_spins',0,'roulette_special_spins',0,'roulette_diamond_spins',0,'diamond_roulette_choice_available',true) else '{}'::jsonb end order by b.rank_key,b.package_level),'[]')
 from public.tc_rank_package_benefits b)) from public.tc_customer_benefit_policy p where p.id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_preview_rank_package_benefit(p_rank_key text, p_package_level smallint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_build_object(
    'rank_key',b.rank_key,'package_level',b.package_level,'enabled',b.enabled,
    'coins',b.coins,'oracle_credits',b.oracle_credits,
    'roulette_level_1_spins',b.roulette_level_1_spins,
    'roulette_level_2_spins',b.roulette_level_2_spins,
    'roulette_level_3_spins',b.roulette_level_3_spins,
    'roulette_special_spins',b.roulette_special_spins,
    'summary',concat_ws(' · ',
      case when b.coins>0 then '+'||b.coins||' Coins' end,
      case when b.oracle_credits>0 then '+'||b.oracle_credits||' Oráculo' end,
      case when b.roulette_level_1_spins>0 then '+'||b.roulette_level_1_spins||' giro N1' end,
      case when b.roulette_level_2_spins>0 then '+'||b.roulette_level_2_spins||' giro N2' end,
      case when b.roulette_level_3_spins>0 then '+'||b.roulette_level_3_spins||' giro N3' end,
      case when b.roulette_special_spins>0 then '+'||b.roulette_special_spins||' giro Especial' end
    )
  ),'{}'::jsonb)
  from public.tc_rank_package_benefits b where b.rank_key=p_rank_key and b.package_level=p_package_level;
$function$
